semantic_profiles.contract: Nullable equality, unmatched preserved-side rows, and repeated projected rows after RIGHT-to-LEFT normalization.
Two nested RIGHT joins, nullable rows, derived projection and subsequent map expression.
Independent and dependent Map definitions around a RIGHT join; null extension and output dependencies survive later global analyses.
Copy definitions above a Filter/Sort/Limit chain with deterministic limited row selection.
An Ensure expression executes only in its valid conditional branch; outer Map expression preserves the result.
Unsupported nullable-side computation movement must preserve both unmatched sides and duplicate multiplicity.
Two consumers of a named derived producer with channel spilling enabled; independent bags cover both consumers.
Same producer/consumers with spilling disabled; result bag must remain identical while physical reuse is separately observed.

timing_limits.explanation: New-RBO analyze serialization ignores queryStats. Legacy JSON compilation metrics are not available in this path. Runtime stage CpuTimeUs measures execution, and runner elapsed time includes startup/execution; neither is optimizer time. CoreDq stage markers lack dedicated stage timings and serialize plans when enabled.
